verdict.rationale: Browserbase docs claim it can spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions and return answers immediately, directly supporting async batch scraping at scale, plus scheduling/deploying agents on demand. However, there is no explicit documentation of a batch-job API, queueing semantics, rate-limit/backoff guidance, or independent hands-on evidence confirming reliability at thousands-of-URL scale. missing for 10: dedicated batch/queue API docs, independent benchmarks or case studies validating thousands-of-URL scraping, and error-handling/retry guarantees at scale.
